[package]
name = "mailviewer-core"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Alexandre Del Bigio"]
description = "Reading and sanitizing of eml and Outlook msg files, without a toolkit"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/alescdb/mailviewer-core"
license = "GPL-3.0+"

[dependencies]
ammonia = "4.1.4"
base64 = "0.23.1"
ctor = "1.0.13"
dtor = "1.0.6"
encoding_rs = "0.8.35"
futures-util = "0.3.34"
gio = "0.22"
gmime = "0.8.1"
hex = "0.4.3"
lazy_static = "1.5.0"
log = "0.4.33"
msg_parser = "0.3.6"

[dependencies.glib]
version = "0.22"
features = ["v2_66"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1.24.1"
features = ["v4"]
